Author: Looneth
Name: AutoTataru
Punchline: Market board automation—buy and sell. One-gil undercuts, handled with extreme prejudice.
Description: Tataru sells for your retainers and shops for your crafts. Sell All prices every listing from recent sales, never below the minimum you set, and reprices anything undercut, one retainer after another or during AutoRetainer's visits. The Buy List imports Teamcraft lists, counts what you already hold, and buys across your data centre within the price ceilings and budgets you choose; cross-world buying needs Lifestream and vnavmesh. Every decision is logged, and /taru stop halts at once. Buying currently needs the English game client.
Changelog: First testing release. Sells for your retainers (Sell All, AutoRetainer turns, sales loop) and buys your Buy List across your data centre, with Teamcraft import, automatic limits, stock counting, NPC price checks, a welcome guide and a switchable theme. Works on any world and data centre; buying needs the English client for now.

Author: Looneth
Name: Bagcheck
Punchline: A shopping list and retainer tracker for crafters.
Description: Know what you need, what you have, and where it's cheapest. Bagcheck keeps count; you do the shopping.
Changelog: First release: a shopping list with Teamcraft import, holdings across bags, crystals, saddlebag and retainers, data-centre prices with NPC vendors and a total, and a Retainers tab.

Author: Looneth
Name: RePlate
Punchline: Save and restore your adventurer plate.
Description: Save your adventurer plate and your gear sets' portraits, and put them back whenever you like. Share them as codes, too.
Changelog: Portraits: a gallery of your gear sets' portraits, saved straight from any gear set, and one portrait put on several gear sets, each opening in turn for you to look over and save. Also a right-click menu for favourites, rename, share and delete, library backups with pictures, plate designs on non-English clients, and a Portraits tour.
